title: Invariant Spacetime Interval
meaning: A Lorentz-invariant quantity classifying separation between two events in one space dimension: timelike (positive), lightlike (zero), or spacelike (negative).
variables: Δt: time separation; Δx: spatial separation; c: speed of light; s²: invariant interval (which can be negative).
conditions: Flat spacetime, one spatial dimension. In 3D replace (Δx)² by (Δx)²+(Δy)²+(Δz)².
commonMistake: Do not treat s² as ordinary Euclidean distance squared; s² may be negative.
